sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chatbots to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how developer tooling around memory, planning, and evaluation is becoming critical infrastructure for production agent deployments.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Shared practical insights on building reliable AI automation workflows using open-source tools. Emphasized the importance of observability and debugging infrastructure when scaling agent-based systems beyond prototypes.

sources.author: Sara Hooker
sources.headline: VP Research @ Cohere & AI researcher
sources.post_summary: Explored the infrastructure challenges of deploying AI agents at scale, particularly around cost optimization, latency, and safety guardrails. Called for better developer tooling to bridge research prototypes and production systems.

sources.author: Matt Rickard
sources.headline: Founder @ Replicate & AI infrastructure investor
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the emerging stack for AI agent development, covering orchestration frameworks, evaluation platforms, and deployment infrastructure. Noted that developer experience tooling is still 2-3 years behind traditional software development.

sources.author: Elena Vasquez
sources.headline: GTM Engineer @ OpenAI | Ex-Salesforce
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a GTM engineering function from scratch, emphasizing the need for product-minded operators who can own outbound automation pipelines and integrate data across CRM, enrichment, and sequencing tools. Highlighted how her team reduced CAC by 34% by treating outbound as a product with version control and A/B testing.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for aligning sales ops with content strategy, explaining how his team uses content performance data to inform outbound sequences and account prioritization. Stressed the importance of closed-loop attribution between content engagement and pipeline creation.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Founder @ RevOps Collective | Former Director, Sales Ops @ Snowflake
sources.post_summary: Wrote about the evolution from traditional sales ops to GTM engineering, arguing that modern revenue teams need engineers who can build internal tooling for lead scoring, enrichment automation, and multi-channel outbound orchestration. Included examples of custom workflows her team deployed.

sources.author: David Okonkwo
sources.headline: VP Sales Ops & Enablement @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Detailed how his team operationalized content strategy by embedding content signals into their outbound automation platform, resulting in higher reply rates. Shared metrics showing the impact of content-informed sequencing on meeting booked rates.

sources.author: Arpit Bhayani
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at DiceDB | Ex-Staff Eng @ AWS
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey building DiceDB from scratch as a solo founder, detailing the technical decisions around building a Redis-compatible database and the challenges of shipping an open-source product alone.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder @ Headlime & Icon | Indie Maker
sources.post_summary: Posted about pivoting from content tools to AI icon generation, explaining how he validated the idea, built the MVP solo in weeks, and launched to early paying users.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Founder @ Row Zero | Ex-Meta
sources.post_summary: Detailed his transition from big tech to founding a startup, sharing weekly progress updates on building a collaborative data platform and lessons from going from zero to first users.

sources.author: Sanket Sahu
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ GeekyAnts | Building NativeBase
sources.post_summary: Wrote about going solo on a side project that became NativeBase, covering the decision to open-source, community growth, and how consistent public updates helped attract contributors.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Founder @ Tally.so | Solo founder
sources.post_summary: Shared a candid update on bootstrapping Tally, including revenue milestones, technical tradeoffs made while shipping new features alone, and reflections on staying lean as a solo founder.
